content.comment_body: Hello, I'm having trouble transferring a program from my PC to a [product_name] module. The transfer doesn't go through, even though the IP settings are correct and I've done similar downloads on other modules without issues. The process doesn't generate any error messages, it just doesn't finish loading the program. My apologies for my English.
Is the [product_name] new? You might find this FAQ useful... It addresses reasons why you may be unable to download programs to a newer [product_name] module.

The software reports no errors, but the download does not complete. Another user suggests referencing a FAQ related to this issue with newer modules.
